newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firms on speculative, T-bill demand.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firms on speculative, T-bill demand.

text.p: The rouble edged up in lively speculative trading on Tuesday as banks sought funds for their clients and for investing in Treasury bills, dealers said.
Roubles/dollar Nov 19 midday Nov 19 early Nov 18 close
"The market is active today. Banks are speculating and fulfilling client orders," an Interbank Finance House dealer said.
But he added tomorrow roubles were traded less actively, and rates were currently unchanged from late Monday levels.

"On the one hand, investors are selling dollars to invest in T-bills but on the other, there are some banks which are ready to buy these dollars," Aljba Alliance Bank chief dealer Dmitry Slobodnik said.
"The dollar has dipped just a little, it is just a technical decline ahead of the auctions as rouble supply is sufficient."
On Wednesday November 20, the central bank is auctioning eight trillion roubles of new six-month paper and an additional tranche of three trillion roubles of six-month bills.
